title: Cloudflare Status - Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-14T05:36:12.243Z
Resolved: 2026-10-15T01:29:39.862Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-15T01:29:39.862Z: resolved - Workers Cron Trigger backlogs have cleared and appear healthy. Cron Trigger schedules should be executing as expected. Some schedule redeploys may be required for a small fraction of Workers who were impacted during the incident.
- 2026-10-14T08:14:16.627Z: monitoring - We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.
- 2026-10-14T07:23:21.018Z: identified - A fix has been identified and is underway
- 2026-10-14T05:36:12.243Z: investigating - Cloudflare is investigating issues with Workers Cron Triggers. Customers who have recently created or modified a Cron Trigger schedule may find that the schedule is not executing as expected. Pre-existing Cron Trigger schedules that have not been recently modified are not affected.

We are working to identify the cause and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.

incident.name: Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues

incident_updates.body: Workers Cron Trigger backlogs have cleared and appear healthy. Cron Trigger schedules should be executing as expected. Some schedule redeploys may be required for a small fraction of Workers who were impacted during the incident.
We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.
A fix has been identified and is underway

Cloudflare is investigating issues with Workers Cron Triggers. Customers who have recently created or modified a Cron Trigger schedule may find that the schedule is not executing as expected. Pre-existing Cron Trigger schedules that have not been recently modified are not affected.

We are working to identify the cause and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
